crossRefs.note: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of…

people.name: Ephron_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the border between Judah and Benjamin

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Nephtoah
people.line: A spring on the border of Judah and Benjamin

translations.web: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
translations.bsb: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.
translations.kjv: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
translations.asv: And the south quarter was from the uttermost part of Kiriath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah;
